desc: Implement the O(n log n) active-flag iterative segment tree solution (arrays sum/pref/suff/best, sentinel -1e15 for padding; merge pref=max(prefL,sumL+prefR), suff=max(suffR,sumR+suffL), best=max(bestL,bestR,suffL+prefR)); build from nums and record no-op answer = root best.

For each distinct negative value, deactivate all its occurrences (2n total point updates with reactivation), take global max with root best, and handle single-distinct-value / all-negative edge cases (operation forbidden when array becomes empty).
Validate against the two provided examples (7 and 10) and against a brute force (try every integer x, filter array, run Kadane) on random small arrays.
No-op / non-negative removal reasoning confirmed: only negative x can help; candidate = M if M>0 else max_nonx (largest element not equal to x).
